#merging dataset
```{python, include=FALSE} 
# Define the folder path
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data"

# Function to read CSV with encoding handling
def read_csv_with_encoding(file_path):
    try:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="utf-8")  # Try UTF-8 first
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="ISO-8859-1")  # Fallback to ISO-8859-1

# Load CSV files with error handling
deltur = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "deltur.csv"))
tur = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "tur.csv"))
journey = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "journey.csv"))
session = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "session.csv"))

# Step 1: Join deltur.csv with tur.csv on "TurId"
df_1 = deltur.merge(tur, on="TurId", how="left")

# Save the merged dataset
output_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "deltur_tur.csv")
df_1.to_csv(output_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")  # Save with safe encoding

# Step 2: Join the result with journey.csv on "SessionId"
df_2 = df_1.merge(journey, on="JourneyId", how="left")

# Save the merged dataset
output_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "deltur_tur_journey.csv")
df_2.to_csv(output_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")  # Save with safe encoding

# Remove columns ending with "_x" and rename "_y" columns
df_2 = df_2[[col for col in df_2.columns if not col.endswith("_x")]]
df_2.columns = [col[:-2] if col.endswith("_y") else col for col in df_2.columns]

# Step 3: Join the result with session.csv on "SessionId"
df_3 = df_2.merge(session, on="SessionId", how="left")

# Save the final merged dataset
output_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "deltur_tur_journey_session.csv")
df_3.to_csv(output_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")  # Save with safe encoding
```

```{python}
# Recalculate number of persons aged 0–9 per household
df_4["Num_0_9"] = df_4["HousehNumPers"] - df_4["HousehNumPers1084"]
df_4["Num_0_9"] = df_4[df_4['AgeSimple'] < 85]
df_4["Is_10_17"] = df_4["AgeSimple"].between(10, 17)

# Group by SessionId (household level)
ten_seventeen_counts = df_4[df_4["Is_10_17"]].groupby("SessionId").size().reset_index(name="Num_10_17")

# Step 3: Get one row per household and merge
household_df = df_4.drop_duplicates("SessionId")[["SessionId", "Num_0_9"]].copy()
household_df = household_df.merge(ten_seventeen_counts, on="SessionId", how="left")
household_df["Num_10_17"] = household_df["Num_10_17"].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Step 4: Categorize
def categorize(row):
    has_0_9 = row["Num_0_9"] > 0
    has_10_17 = row["Num_10_17"] > 0

    if has_0_9 and has_10_17:
        return "With Children 0–9 & With 10–17"
    elif has_0_9 and not has_10_17:
        return "With Children 0–9 & Without 10–17"
    elif not has_0_9 and has_10_17:
        return "Without Children 0–9 & With 10–17"
    else:
        return "Without Children 0–9 & Without 10–17"

household_df["Category"] = household_df.apply(categorize, axis=1)

# Step 5: Count and summarize
summary_df = household_df["Category"].value_counts().reset_index()
summary_df.columns = ["Category", "Count"]
total_households = household_df.shape[0]
summary_df["Percentage"] = (summary_df["Count"] / total_households * 100).round(2)

# Optional: Add total row
summary_df = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame({
        "Category": ["Total Households"],
        "Count": [total_households],
        "Percentage": [100.0]
    }),
    summary_df
], ignore_index=True)

print(summary_df)
```

#Classify the type of journey
```{python, include=FALSE}
# Define folder path
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data"
filtered_df_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "merged_filtered.csv")

# Load dataset
final_df_filtered = pd.read_csv(filtered_df_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# Standardize column names (remove spaces)
final_df_filtered.columns = final_df_filtered.columns.str.strip()

# Ensure required columns exist
required_columns = ["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10", "JourneyId"]
missing_columns = [col for col in required_columns if col not in final_df_filtered.columns]

if missing_columns:
    raise ValueError(f"❌ ERROR: Missing columns: {missing_columns}")

# Replace NaN values with 0
final_df_filtered[["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10"]] = final_df_filtered[["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10"]].fillna(0)

# Convert to integer types
final_df_filtered["PartyNum1017"] = final_df_filtered["PartyNum1017"].astype(int)
final_df_filtered["PartyNumu10"] = final_df_filtered["PartyNumu10"].astype(int)

# Function to classify journeys
def classify_journey(df):
    # Identify journeys with any children present
    journey_with_children = df.groupby("JourneyId")[["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10"]].apply(
        lambda x: 1 if (x["PartyNum1017"].gt(0).all() or x["PartyNumu10"].gt(0).all()) else  # Every trip in the journey has at least one "PartyNum1017" or "PartyNumu10"
                  2 if (x["PartyNum1017"].gt(0).any() or x["PartyNumu10"].gt(0).any()) else  # Some trips in the journey have at least one "PartyNum1017" or "PartyNumu10"
                  3  # No trips in the journey have children
    )
    
    # Merge back to the main dataframe
    df = df.merge(journey_with_children.rename("JourneyWithChildren"), on="JourneyId", how="left")
    return df

# Apply classification
final_df_filtered_0to17 = classify_journey(final_df_filtered)

# Save the updated dataset
output_classified_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "translated_filtered_classified_0to9.csv")
final_df_filtered_0to17.to_csv(output_classified_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```


#categorize modes
```{python, include=FALSE}
# Define folder path
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data"
csv_file_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "translated_filtered_classified_0to9.csv")

# Now read the actual file
final_df_filtered_0to17 = pd.read_csv(csv_file_path)

if "JourneyWithChildren" not in final_df_filtered_0to17.columns:
    final_df_filtered_0to17 = classify_journey(final_df_filtered_0to17)

# Define Mode Mapping for PrimMode
mode_mapping = {
    1: "Walk", 
    2: "Bicycle", 
    11: "Motorized Transport", 
    12: "Motorized Transport", 
    13: "Motorized Transport", 
    14: "Motorized Transport", 
    25: "Public Transport", 
    31: "Public Transport", 
    32: "Public Transport", 
    33: "Public Transport", 
    34: "Public Transport", 
    35: "Public Transport", 
    37: "Public Transport", 
    41: "Public Transport"
}

# Ensure journey classification is applied first
if "JourneyWithChildren" not in final_df_filtered_0to17.columns:
    final_df_filtered_0to17 = classify_journey(final_df_filtered_0to17)  # Apply function if missing

# Filter dataset for selected PrimMode values
filtered_modes = final_df_filtered_0to17[final_df_filtered_0to17["PrimMode"].isin(mode_mapping.keys())].copy()

# Create a new column 'primode_cat' with the corresponding categories
filtered_modes["primode_cat"] = filtered_modes["PrimMode"].map(mode_mapping)

# Ensure JourneyWithChildren column is not missing
if "JourneyWithChildren" in filtered_modes.columns:
    # Remove NaN values in JourneyWithChildren
    filtered_modes_0to17 = filtered_modes.dropna(subset=["JourneyWithChildren"])

    # Group by JourneyId to avoid double-counting and get the primary mode
    journey_modes_0to17 = (
        filtered_modes_0to17.groupby(["JourneyId", "JourneyWithChildren"])["primode_cat"]
        .agg(lambda x: x.mode()[0] if not x.mode().empty else x.iloc[0])  # Select most common mode
        .reset_index()
    )

    # Count occurrences of each mode within JourneyWithChildren categories
    mode_counts_0to17 = journey_modes_0to17.pivot_table(index="JourneyWithChildren", columns="primode_cat", aggfunc="size", fill_value=0)

    # Rename JourneyWithChildren categories
    category_labels = {1: "Every trip had children", 2: "Some trips had children", 3: "No trips had children"}
    mode_counts_0to17.index = mode_counts_0to17.index.map(category_labels)

    # Add a "Total Count" column
    mode_counts_0to17["Total"] = mode_counts_0to17.sum(axis=1)

    # Reset index without "primode_cat" as a column
    mode_counts_0to17_df = mode_counts_0to17.reset_index()

    # Ensure correct column renaming
    mode_counts_0to17_df.columns.name = None  # Remove any column group names

    # Rename the first column properly
    mode_counts_0to17_df = mode_counts_0to17_df.rename(columns={"JourneyWithChildren": "Category"})
    mode_counts_0to17_df = mode_counts_0to17_df.reset_index(drop=True)

    # Ensure **primode_cat is completely removed**
    if "primode_cat" in mode_counts_0to17_df.columns:
        mode_counts_0to17_df = mode_counts_0to17_df.drop(columns=["primode_cat"])

    # Display the cleaned mode count table
    display(mode_counts_0to17_df)

    # Define the folder path and save the dataframe to CSV
    folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data"
    output_file = os.path.join(folder_path, "filtered_modes_with_categories_0to9.csv")
    filtered_modes_0to17.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
    print(f"Data saved to {output_file}")

else:
    print("🚨 ERROR: 'JourneyWithChildren' column is missing after filtering. Check if classify_journey() was applied correctly.")
```

#Age group of the accompanied kids on a trip
```{python, include=FALSE}
# Define folder path
folder_path = r"C:\Users\ohdaw\OneDrive - Harvard University\tu_data"
filtered_modes_0to17 = os.path.join(folder_path, "filtered_modes_with_categories_0to9.csv")

# Read data
df = pd.read_csv(filtered_modes_0to17, low_memory=False)

# Function to classify journeys
def classify_journey(df):
    # Drop existing JourneyWithChildren if present
    if "JourneyWithChildren" in df.columns:
        df = df.drop(columns=["JourneyWithChildren"])

    # Identify journeys with any children present
    journey_with_children = df.groupby("JourneyId")[["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10"]].apply(
        lambda x: 0 if x[["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10"]].gt(0).all().all() else  # Every trip has children
                  1 if x[["PartyNum1017", "PartyNumu10"]].gt(0).any().any() else  # Some trips have children
                  2  # No trips have children
    ).rename("JourneyWithChildren")

    # Assign the column directly instead of merging
    df = df.join(journey_with_children, on="JourneyId")

    # Create a new column indicating the presence of specific child age groups
    def child_presence(row):
        if row["PartyNumu10"] > 0 and row["PartyNum1017"] > 0:
            return "Both 0-9 and 10-17"
        elif row["PartyNumu10"] > 0:
            return "0-9 only"
        elif row["PartyNum1017"] > 0:
            return "10-17 only"
        else:
            return "No children"

    df["ChildPresence"] = df.apply(child_presence, axis=1)

    return df

# Apply classification
data_classified = classify_journey(df)

# Save the updated dataset
output_classified_path = os.path.join(folder_path, "data_classified_0to9.csv")
data_classified.to_csv(output_classified_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```
